# Renton & Newcastle Dispatch

> The Renton & Newcastle Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Renton and Newcastle, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Renton & Newcastle](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Standards](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Downtown Renton](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/downtown-renton/): Renton's City Center, from South 3rd Street and Wells Avenue South past Liberty Park and the Cedar River Trail to the lake, with the Renton Transit Center, the municipal airport and The Landing on Logan Avenue North.
- [Kennydale](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/kennydale/): The hillside between I-405 and Lake Washington, with Gene Coulon Memorial Beach Park, Kennydale Beach Park along Lake Washington Boulevard North and May Creek at its north edge.
- [Highlands](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/highlands/): The plateau above downtown along NE Sunset Boulevard and NE 4th Street, with the Renton Highlands Library on NE 10th Street and the Sunset Area being rebuilt around it.
- [East Plateau](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/east-plateau/): The city's eastern edge along NE 4th Street and Duvall Avenue NE, where the plateau rises toward the Cougar Mountain foothills and May Valley.
- [Cedar River](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/cedar-river/): The Cedar River valley east of downtown along the Maple Valley Highway, with the Cedar River Trail, Ron Regis Park and Maplewood Golf Course.
- [Benson Hill](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/benson-hill/): The hill south of downtown along 108th Avenue SE and SE Carr Road, between Talbot Hill and Fairwood, with Panther Creek running down its west side.
- [Talbot Hill](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/talbot-hill/): The ridge between the valley floor and Benson Hill along Talbot Road South, with Talbot Hill Reservoir Park, Valley Medical Center and the Springbrook Trail.
- [Fairwood](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/fairwood/): Unincorporated King County with Renton addresses, on the plateau along SE Petrovitsky Road and 140th Avenue SE, around the Fairwood golf course, with Lake Youngs and its perimeter trail to the southeast.
- [Lake Boren](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/lake-boren/): The center of Newcastle around Lake Boren Park, with China Creek Park, the Waterline Trail and the Newcastle Commons shops on Coal Creek Parkway SE.
- [Hazelwood](https://www.rentonnewcastledispatch.com/hazelwood/): Newcastle's west side above I-405 and Lake Washington, with Hazelwood Park and its restored forest and the May Creek greenway to the south.
